description: Phase 1 performance budgets for the Architech public prototype. Re-baselined 25 Aug 2026 after the parity overlay added public calculator/editorial pages and an agent workspace: first-load gzip cap raised to 235 KB and total static JS cap to 2.15 MiB to accommodate the new surfaces (max measured /search first-load gzip 226.8 KiB, total static JS 2089.7 KiB), keeping headroom so real regressions are still caught. Per-route raw first-load and core-web-vital targets remain unchanged.
